{{Top|leg}}
'''Liquid cable''' was a liquid that hardened upon contact with [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] or the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to create a lightweight but strong flexible cable. [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|Liquid-cable launchers]] had a reservoir containing liquid cable in the middle of the device which held enough volume to fabricate twenty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of cable that could support up to five hundred [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
